name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia is an all-in-one AI video creation platform for businesses, letting users produce professional videos with AI avatars and voices without cameras, actors, or production studios.
best_for: Learning and development departments, sales-enablement teams, HR training programs, marketing departments, and compliance/technical training across manufacturing, tech, healthcare, and financial services.
features: 240+ AI avatars and 1,000+ AI voices across 160+ languages
AI screen recorder with instant transcripts
One-click video translation and AI dubbing into 160+ languages
Real-time team collaboration with brand kits and version control
SCORM export for LMS integration and detailed viewer analytics

alternatives.name: Runway
alternatives.description: An AI creative suite and developer API for generating and editing cinematic video, image, and audio content.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting generative, cinematic video rather than avatar-led presenter videos.
strengths: Developer API for custom media pipelines

alternatives.name: ElevenLabs
alternatives.description: An AI audio platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning, and conversational voice agents.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing standalone voice generation or dubbing without a full avatar-video suite.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: 10 minutes of video creation or dubbing, 3 survey responses, and 500 credits per month; videos carry a Synthesia watermark.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Self-serve paid plan; annual billing is discounted.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Creator was renamed Pro on October 1, 2026; annual billing is discounted.

cons: Synthesia uses a credit system across AI features, so included video minutes do not fully describe usage limits for dubbing, surveys, avatars, and other credit-consuming features.
Basic exports carry a Synthesia watermark; Enterprise pricing is custom.
